pr_title: Capture Endpoint and Routes Values in IStatusCodeReExecuteFeature

issue_context.title: Capture Endpoint and RouteValues on IStatusCodeReExecuteFeature
issue_context.body:
## Background and Motivation
Capture original Endpoint and route values in `IStatusCodeReExecuteFeature`. The same thing has been done for `IExceptionHandlerFeature` in #34205.

## Proposed API

```diff
namespace Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics
{
    public interface IStatusCodeReExecuteFeature
    {
+       /// <summary>
+       /// Gets the selected <see cref="Http.Endpoint"/> for the original request.
+       /// </summary>
+       Endpoint? Endpoint { get; }

+       /// <summary>
+       /// Gets the <see cref="RouteValueDictionary"/> associated with the original request.
+       /// </summary>
+       RouteValueDictionary? RouteValues { get; }
    }
}
```

comments: How do you think this would be used?

> How do you think this would be used?

It gives the ability to create different body based on original endpoint metadata. For example the body for an API endpoint could be different than the body for a razor endpoint.

The original endpoint is being cleared in here 
https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/8b30d862de6c9146f466061d51aa3f1414ee2337/src/Middleware/Diagnostics/src/StatusCodePage/StatusCodePagesExtensions.cs#L195-L199
I understand that in theory but, do you have an example of when you would need to do this? Are you thinking problem details vs html?

> Are you thinking problem details vs html?

Yes this is what I have in mind, when an application is both serving API and html and needs different type of response, but I have to say I don't need this API myself at the moment. I'm just suggesting it in case it might be useful to others.
Seems reasonable, I'm not sure it meets the bar this late in the game though

This is something that could be done with a workaround which is have a custom middleware which store endpoint after routing middleware to another feature, so nobody would be blocked because of this in 6.0.
If you agree with the proposal, I'll send a PR for main.

review_comments:
Now that the instance of `RouteValues` is stored in `IStatusCodeReExecuteFeature.RouteValues`, calling `Clear()` would also clear that. So I had to change it, unless we create a copy of `RouteValues`.
Also I did the same for `ExceptionHandlerMiddleware` https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/34205/files#r666509631.
